plain.li: [nemesisreturn,first] A year since {ENEMY} came back. Stood at my old spot at dusk and looked out the way they came.
[nemesisreturn,years] {YEARS} years since {ENEMY} came back. We tell it at supper now like any other story.
[nemesisreturn] The day {ENEMY} came back. What I remember most is the noise.

blunt.li: [nemesisreturn] {ENEMY} came back on this day, and we held.

gloomy.li: [nemesisreturn] Every year on this day I wonder if {ENEMY} will try again.

cold.li: [nemesisreturn] Marked the date {ENEMY} returned. Our defenses were adequate then. They are better now.

plain.li: [nemesisreturn,first] A year ago today {ENEMY}, who had got away once before, came back with a raid. The colony held, and {A_nameDef} hasn't forgotten a minute of it.
[nemesisreturn,years] {YEARS} years ago today, {ENEMY} came back and was seen off again. {A_nameDef} still shows anyone who asks where {A_pronoun} stood that day.
[nemesisreturn] On this day {ENEMY} came back for the colony and went away with nothing. {A_nameDef} walked the old defensive line at first light.
[nemesisreturn] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about the day {ENEMY} came back, and where each of them stood.
